data.one_liner: Cross‑platform image format conversion and resizing using native APIs
data.what_it_does: Converts images between JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF and resizes them while preserving EXIF orientation. It uses platform‑native APIs via FFI/JNI for high performance.
use_when: Need fast, native image conversion on multiple platforms
Need to handle HEIC/AVIF on supported OSes
avoid_when: Working in a pure Dart/Flutter web environment without native plugins
Need a lightweight dependency for simple image loading only
strengths: Supports many formats and resizing modes
weaknesses: Platform‑specific limitations (e.g., WebP output not on iOS)
Large binary size due to native code
data.setup_notes: Add plugin to pubspec, run flutter pub get. No build_runner needed. On Android, ensure minSdk 7; on iOS, deployment target 14.0. No special permissions required.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Dart image manipulation, no native dependencies
